Approve to continue?\n**Required Tools:** run_command\n```python\nquery_script = """\\\nimport sqlite3\nimport json\n\nconn = sqlite3.connect(\'/workspace/world.db\')\nconn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\ncursor = conn.cursor()\n\n# First, see what tables exist\ncursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\'table\'")\ntables = [row[\'name\'] for row in cursor.fetchall()]\nprint(f"Tables: {tables}")\n\n# Look at the schema of each table\nfor table in tables:\n    cursor.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")\n    cols = [(row[\'name\'], row[\'type\']) for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n    print(f"\\\\n{table} columns: {cols}")\n    cursor.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM {table}")\n    count = cursor.fetchone()[\'cnt\']\n    print(f"{table} row count: {count}")\n\nconn.close()\n"""\nawait write_file("./query_db.py", query_script)\nprint("Script written")\n\ndb_schema = await run_command("python ./query_db.py")\nprint(db_schema)\n\nflight_query = """\\\nimport sqlite3\nimport json\n\nconn = sqlite3.connect(\'/workspace/world.db\')\nconn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\ncursor = conn.cursor()\n\n# Get all flights and look for JFK -> LHR routes\ncursor.execute("SELECT * FROM flights LIMIT 3")\nsample_rows = [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]\nprint("Sample flight rows:")\nfor r in sample_rows:\n    # Truncate long values for readability\n    for k, v in r.items():\n        if isinstance(v, str) and len(v) > 200:\n            r[k] = v[:200] + \'...\'\n    print(json.dumps(r, indent=2))\n\n# Search for flights with JFK origin and LHR destination\nprint("\\\\n=== Searching for JFK -> LHR flights ===")\ncursor.execute("SELECT * FROM flights WHERE origin=\'JFK\' AND destination=\'LHR\'")\njfk_lhr = [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]\nprint(f"Found {len(jfk_lhr)} JFK -> LHR flights")\n\nif jfk_lhr:\n    for f in jfk_lhr:\n        print(f"\\\\nFlight: {f.get(\'flight_number\', \'N/A\')}")\n        print(f"  Origin: {f.get(\'origin\')} -> Destination: {f.get(\'destination\')}")\n        # Parse dates/prices if stored as JSON\n        dates_data = f.get(\'dates\', \'\')\n        if dates_data:\n            try:\n                dates_parsed = json.loads(dates_data) if isinstance(dates_data, str) else dates_data\n                for date_key, date_info in (dates_parsed.items() if isinstance(dates_parsed, dict) else []):\n                    status = date_info.get(\'status\', \'N/A\') if isinstance(date_info, dict) else \'N/A\'\n                    prices = date_info.get(\'prices\', {}) if isinstance(date_info, dict) else {}\n                    print(f"  Date: {date_key} | Status: {status} | Prices: {prices}")\n            except:\n                print(f"  Dates (raw): {str(dates_data)[:300]}")\nelse:\n    # Check what origins/destinations exist\n    print("\\\\nNo JFK->LHR flights. Checking available origins with JFK:")\n    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT destination FROM flights WHERE origin=\'JFK\'")\n    jfk_dests = [row[\'destination\'] for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n    print(f"JFK destinations: {jfk_dests}")\n    \n    print("\\\\nChecking if LHR exists as destination:")\n    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT origin FROM flights WHERE destination=\'LHR\'")\n    lhr_origins = [row[\'origin\'] for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n    print(f"Origins to LHR: {lhr_origins}")\n    \n    print("\\\\nAll unique origin-destination pairs:")\n    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT origin, destination FROM flights ORDER BY origin, destination")\n    all_routes = [(row[\'origin\'], row[\'destination\']) for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n    print(f"Total unique routes: {len(all_routes)}")\n    for o, d in all_routes:\n        print(f"  {o} -> {d}")\n\nconn.close()\n"""\nawait write_file("./flight_query.py", flight_query)\nprint("Script written")\n\nflight_results = await run_command("python ./flight_query.py")\nprint(flight_results)\n```'}}

Parse cabin prices\n    if f[\'cabin_prices_json\']:\n        prices = json.loads(f[\'cabin_prices_json\'])\n        print(f"Cabin Prices: {json.dumps(prices, indent=4)}")\n    \n    # Parse dates with availability\n    if f[\'dates_json\']:\n        dates = json.loads(f[\'dates_json\'])\n        print(f"Available Dates:")\n        for date_key, date_info in sorted(dates.items()):\n            status = date_info.get(\'status\', \'N/A\')\n            date_prices = date_info.get(\'prices\', {})\n            seats = date_info.get(\'available_seats\', {})\n            print(f"  {date_key}: Status={status}")\n            print(f"    Prices: {json.dumps(date_prices)}")\n            if seats:\n                print(f"    Available Seats: {json.dumps(seats)}")\n    print()\n\n# Also check if there are any existing bookings for JFK->LHR\ncursor.execute("SELECT booking_id, user_id, flight_id, status, cabin_class, price_paid FROM flight_bookings WHERE origin=\'JFK\' AND destination=\'LHR\'")\nbookings = [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]\nprint(f"\\\\nExisting JFK->LHR bookings: {len(bookings)}")\nfor b in bookings:\n    print(f"  Booking {b[\'booking_id\']}: user={b[\'user_id\']}, flight={b[\'flight_id\']}, status={b[\'status\']}, cabin={b[\'cabin_class\']}, paid=${b[\'price_paid\']}")\n\nconn.close()\n"""\nawait write_file("./jfk_lhr_details.py", jfk_lhr_detail_script)\nprint("Script written")\n\njfk_lhr_output = await run_command("python ./jfk_lhr_details.py")\nprint(jfk_lhr_output)\n```'}}

WHERE flight_id=?", (dep, arr, fid))\n        changed = True\n\n    for date_key, date_data in dates.items():\n        if not isinstance(date_data, dict):\n            continue\n        if isinstance(date_data.get(\'prices\'), dict):\n            invalid_keys = [k for k in date_data[\'prices\'] if k not in VALID_CABINS]\n            for k in invalid_keys:\n                del date_data[\'prices\'][k]\n                changed = True\n        if isinstance(date_data.get(\'available_seats\'), dict):\n            invalid_keys = [k for k in date_data[\'available_seats\'] if k not in VALID_CABINS]\n            for k in invalid_keys:\n                del date_data[\'available_seats\'][k]\n                changed = True\n        if date_data.get(\'status\') not in VALID_STATUSES:\n            date_data[\'status\'] = \'available\'\n            changed = True\n\n    if changed:\n        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?\', (dep, arr, fid))\n        changed = True\n\n    for date_key, date_data in dates.items():\n        if not isinstance(date_data, dict):\n            continue\n        if isinstance(date_data.get(\'prices\'), dict):\n            invalid_keys = [k for k in date_data[\'prices\'] if k not in VALID_CABINS]\n            for k in invalid_keys:\n                del date_data[\'prices\'][k]\n                changed = True\n        if isinstance(date_data.get(\'available_seats\'), dict):\n            invalid_keys = [k for k in date_data[\'available_seats\'] if k not in VALID_CABINS]\n            for k in invalid_keys:\n                del date_data[\'available_seats\'][k]\n                changed = True\n        if date_data.get(\'status\') not in VALID_STATUSES:\n            date_data[\'status\'] = \'available\'\n            changed = True\n\n    if changed:\n        cursor.execute(\'UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? Now get reservation details before update\nget_res_cmd = """python -c "\nimport sys, json\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nprint(\'=== CURRENT RESERVATION ===\')\nres = tools.get_reservation_details(\'BK-B70889\')\nprint(res.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n"\n"""\nres_output = await run_command(get_res_cmd)\nprint(res_output)\n\n# Now perform the update\nupdate_cmd = """python -c "\nimport sys, json\nsys.path.insert(0, \'skills/tau2Airline/src\')\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB\nfrom tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools\n\ndb = FlightDB.load()\ntools = AirlineTools(db)\n\nprint(\'=== PERFORMING UPDATE ===\')\nresult = tools.update_reservation_flights(\n    reservation_id=\'BK-B70889\',\n    cabin=\'business\',\n    flights=[{\'flight_number\': \'FLABBF26\', \'date\': \'2026-09-10\'}],\n    payment_id=\'cc_b3676891\'\n)\nprint(\'Update result:\')\nprint(result.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n\ndb.save()\nprint()\nprint(\'Database saved!\')\n\nprint()\nprint(\'=== UPDATED RESERVATION ===\')\nres_after = tools.get_reservation_details(\'BK-B70889\')\nprint(res_after.model_dump_json(indent=2))\n"\n"""\nupdate_output = await run_command(update_cmd)\nprint(update_output[:8000])\n\n# See the rest\nprint(update_output[8000:])\n```'}}

import sqlite3

conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Get all flights and look for JFK -> LHR routes
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM flights LIMIT 3")
sample_rows = [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
print("Sample flight rows:")
for r in sample_rows:
    # Truncate long values for readability
    for k, v in r.items():
        if isinstance(v, str) and len(v) > 200:
            r[k] = v[:200] + '...'
    print(json.dumps(r, indent=2))

# Search for flights with JFK origin and LHR destination
print("\\n=== Searching for JFK -> LHR flights ===")
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM flights WHERE origin='JFK' AND destination='LHR'")
jfk_lhr = [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
print(f"Found {len(jfk_lhr)} JFK -> LHR flights")

if jfk_lhr:
    for f in jfk_lhr:
        print(f"\\nFlight: {f.get('flight_number', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"  Origin: {f.get('origin')} -> Destination: {f.get('destination')}")
        # Parse dates/prices if stored as JSON
        dates_data = f.get('dates', '')
        if dates_data:
            try:
                dates_parsed = json.loads(dates_data) if isinstance(dates_data, str) else dates_data
                for date_key, date_info in (dates_parsed.items() if isinstance(dates_parsed, dict) else []):
                    status = date_info.get('status', 'N/A') if isinstance(date_info, dict) else 'N/A'
                    prices = date_info.get('prices', {}) if isinstance(date_info, dict) else {}
                    print(f"  Date: {date_key} | Status: {status} | Prices: {prices}")
            except:
                print(f"  Dates (raw): {str(dates_data)[:300]}")
else:
    # Check what origins/destinations exist
    print("\\nNo JFK->LHR flights. Checking available origins with JFK:")
    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT destination FROM flights WHERE origin='JFK'")
    jfk_dests = [row['destination'] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    print(f"JFK destinations: {jfk_dests}")
    
    print("\\nChecking if LHR exists as destination:")
    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT origin FROM flights WHERE destination='LHR'")
    lhr_origins = [row['origin'] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    print(f"Origins to LHR: {lhr_origins}")
    
    print("\\nAll unique origin-destination pairs:")
    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT origin, destination FROM flights ORDER BY origin, destination")
    all_routes = [(row['origin'], row['destination']) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    print(f"Total unique routes: {len(all_routes)}")
    for o, d in all_routes:
        print(f"  {o} -> {d}")

conn.close()
"""

    print(f"Departure: {f['departure_time']}")
    print(f"Arrival: {f['arrival_time']}")

# First, let's see what the flights table looks like and fix the premium_economy issue
fix_script = """\
import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Find all flights with premium_economy in their prices
cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json FROM flights WHERE cabin_prices_json LIKE '%premium_economy%'")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
print(f"Found {len(rows)} flights with premium_economy pricing")

# Remove premium_economy from each flight's cabin_prices_json
updated = 0
for row in rows:
    fid = row['flight_id']
    prices = json.loads(row['cabin_prices_json'])
    if 'premium_economy' in prices:
        del prices['premium_economy']
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET cabin_prices_json=? WHERE flight_id=?", (json.dumps(prices), fid))
        updated += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Updated {updated} flights to remove premium_economy")

# Also check the flight_dates table if it exists
cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
tables = [r['name'] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
print(f"Tables: {tables}")

# Check if there's a flight_dates table with prices
if 'flight_dates' in tables:
    cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flight_dates WHERE cabin_prices_json LIKE '%premium_economy%'")
    cnt = cursor.fetchone()['cnt']
    print(f"flight_dates with premium_economy: {cnt}")
    
    cursor.execute("SELECT flight_number, date, cabin_prices_json FROM flight_dates WHERE cabin_prices_json LIKE '%premium_economy%'")
    fd_rows = cursor.fetchall()
    fd_updated = 0
    for row in fd_rows:
        prices = json.loads(row['cabin_prices_json'])
        if 'premium_economy' in prices:
            del prices['premium_economy']
            cursor.execute("UPDATE flight_dates SET cabin_prices_json=? WHERE flight_number=? AND date=?", 
                         (json.dumps(prices), row['flight_number'], row['date']))
            fd_updated += 1
    conn.commit()
    print(f"Updated {fd_updated} flight_dates to remove premium_economy")

conn.close()
print("Done fixing database")
"""

fix_all = """\
import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

VALID_CABINS = {'business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'}
VALID_STATUSES = {'available', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed', 'flying', 'on time'}

# Fix all flights
cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, dates_json, departure_time, arrival_time FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
print(f"Total tau2Airline flights: {len(rows)}")

updated = 0
for row in rows:
    fid = row['flight_id']
    dep = row['departure_time'] or ''
    arr = row['arrival_time'] or ''
    dates_raw = row['dates_json'] or '{}'
    dates = json.loads(dates_raw)
    
    changed = False
    
    # Fix None departure/arrival times
    if row['departure_time'] is None or row['arrival_time'] is None:
        if not dep:
            dep = '00:00'
        if not arr:
            arr = '00:00'
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET departure_time=?, arrival_time=? WHERE flight_id=?", (dep, arr, fid))
        changed = True
    
    # Fix dates_json
    for date_key, date_data in dates.items():
        if not isinstance(date_data, dict):
            continue
        
        # Fix invalid cabin keys in prices
        if isinstance(date_data.get('prices'), dict):
            invalid_keys = [k for k in date_data['prices'] if k not in VALID_CABINS]
            for k in invalid_keys:
                del date_data['prices'][k]
                changed = True
        
        # Fix invalid cabin keys in available_seats (only if dict)
        if isinstance(date_data.get('available_seats'), dict):
            invalid_keys = [k for k in date_data['available_seats'] if k not in VALID_CABINS]
            for k in invalid_keys:
                del date_data['available_seats'][k]
                changed = True
        
        # Fix invalid status values
        if date_data.get('status') not in VALID_STATUSES:
            date_data['status'] = 'available'
            changed = True
    
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?", (json.dumps(dates), fid))
        updated += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Updated {updated} flights")

# Verify
cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flights WHERE dates_json LIKE '%first%' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
print(f"Remaining with 'first': {cursor.fetchone()['cnt']}")

cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flights WHERE departure_time IS NULL AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
print(f"Remaining with NULL departure: {cursor.fetchone()['cnt']}")

cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flights WHERE dates_json LIKE '%premium_economy%' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
print(f"Remaining with premium_economy: {cursor.fetchone()['cnt']}")

cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flights WHERE dates_json LIKE '%\"active\"%' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
print(f"Remaining with 'active' status: {cursor.fetchone()['cnt']}")

conn.close()
print("All fixes complete")
"""

import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

# First, see what tables exist

tables = [row['name'] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
print(f"Tables: {tables}")

# Look at the schema of each table
for table in tables:
    cursor.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")
    cols = [(row['name'], row['type']) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    print(f"\\n{table} columns: {cols}")
    cursor.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM {table}")
    count = cursor.fetchone()['cnt']
    print(f"{table} row count: {count}")

conn.close()
"""

flight_query = """\
import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Get all flights and look for JFK -> LHR routes
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM flights LIMIT 3")
sample_rows = [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
print("Sample flight rows:")
for r in sample_rows:
    # Truncate long values for readability
    for k, v in r.items():
        if isinstance(v, str) and len(v) > 200:
            r[k] = v[:200] + '...'
    print(json.dumps(r, indent=2))

# Search for flights with JFK origin and LHR destination
print("\\n=== Searching for JFK -> LHR flights ===")
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM flights WHERE origin='JFK' AND destination='LHR'")
jfk_lhr = [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
print(f"Found {len(jfk_lhr)} JFK -> LHR flights")

if jfk_lhr:
    for f in jfk_lhr:
        print(f"\\nFlight: {f.get('flight_number', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"  Origin: {f.get('origin')} -> Destination: {f.get('destination')}")
        # Parse dates/prices if stored as JSON
        dates_data = f.get('dates', '')
        if dates_data:
            try:
                dates_parsed = json.loads(dates_data) if isinstance(dates_data, str) else dates_data
                for date_key, date_info in (dates_parsed.items() if isinstance(dates_parsed, dict) else []):
                    status = date_info.get('status', 'N/A') if isinstance(date_info, dict) else 'N/A'
                    prices = date_info.get('prices', {}) if isinstance(date_info, dict) else {}
                    print(f"  Date: {date_key} | Status: {status} | Prices: {prices}")
            except:
                print(f"  Dates (raw): {str(dates_data)[:300]}")
else:
    # Check what origins/destinations exist
    print("\\nNo JFK->LHR flights. Checking available origins with JFK:")
    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT destination FROM flights WHERE origin='JFK'")
    jfk_dests = [row['destination'] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    print(f"JFK destinations: {jfk_dests}")
    
    print("\\nChecking if LHR exists as destination:")
    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT origin FROM flights WHERE destination='LHR'")
    lhr_origins = [row['origin'] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    print(f"Origins to LHR: {lhr_origins}")
    
    print("\\nAll unique origin-destination pairs:")
    cursor.execute("SELECT DISTINCT origin, destination FROM flights ORDER BY origin, destination")
    all_routes = [(row['origin'], row['destination']) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    print(f"Total unique routes: {len(all_routes)}")
    for o, d in all_routes:
        print(f"  {o} -> {d}")

conn.close()
"""

# First, let's see what the flights table looks like and fix the premium_economy issue
fix_script = """\
import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Find all flights with premium_economy in their prices
cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json FROM flights WHERE cabin_prices_json LIKE '%premium_economy%'")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
print(f"Found {len(rows)} flights with premium_economy pricing")

# Remove premium_economy from each flight's cabin_prices_json
updated = 0
for row in rows:
    fid = row['flight_id']
    prices = json.loads(row['cabin_prices_json'])
    if 'premium_economy' in prices:
        del prices['premium_economy']
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET cabin_prices_json=? WHERE flight_id=?", (json.dumps(prices), fid))
        updated += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Updated {updated} flights to remove premium_economy")

# Also check the flight_dates table if it exists
cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")
tables = [r['name'] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
print(f"Tables: {tables}")

# Check if there's a flight_dates table with prices
if 'flight_dates' in tables:
    cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flight_dates WHERE cabin_prices_json LIKE '%premium_economy%'")
    cnt = cursor.fetchone()['cnt']
    print(f"flight_dates with premium_economy: {cnt}")
    
    cursor.execute("SELECT flight_number, date, cabin_prices_json FROM flight_dates WHERE cabin_prices_json LIKE '%premium_economy%'")
    fd_rows = cursor.fetchall()
    fd_updated = 0
    for row in fd_rows:
        prices = json.loads(row['cabin_prices_json'])
        if 'premium_economy' in prices:
            del prices['premium_economy']
            cursor.execute("UPDATE flight_dates SET cabin_prices_json=? WHERE flight_number=? AND date=?", 
                         (json.dumps(prices), row['flight_number'], row['date']))
            fd_updated += 1
    conn.commit()
    print(f"Updated {fd_updated} flight_dates to remove premium_economy")

conn.close()
print("Done fixing database")
"""
await write_file("./fix_db.py", fix_script)
print("Script written")

import sqlite3

    fid = row['flight_id']

    for date_key, date_data in dates.items():
        if 'prices' in date_data and 'premium_economy' in date_data['prices']:
            del date_data['prices']['premium_economy']
            changed = True
        if 'available_seats' in date_data and 'premium_economy' in date_data['available_seats']:
            del date_data['available_seats']['premium_economy']

        updated += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Updated {updated} flights dates_json to remove premium_economy")

conn.close()
print("Fix complete")

fix_all = """\
import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

VALID_CABINS = {'business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'}
VALID_STATUSES = {'available', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed', 'flying', 'on time'}

# Fix all flights
cursor.execute("SELECT flight_id, dates_json, departure_time, arrival_time FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
print(f"Total tau2Airline flights: {len(rows)}")

updated = 0
for row in rows:
    fid = row['flight_id']
    dep = row['departure_time'] or ''
    arr = row['arrival_time'] or ''
    dates_raw = row['dates_json'] or '{}'
    dates = json.loads(dates_raw)
    
    changed = False
    
    # Fix None departure/arrival times
    if row['departure_time'] is None or row['arrival_time'] is None:
        if not dep:
            dep = '00:00'
        if not arr:
            arr = '00:00'
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET departure_time=?, arrival_time=? WHERE flight_id=?", (dep, arr, fid))
        changed = True
    
    # Fix dates_json
    for date_key, date_data in dates.items():
        if not isinstance(date_data, dict):
            continue
        
        # Fix invalid cabin keys in prices
        if isinstance(date_data.get('prices'), dict):
            invalid_keys = [k for k in date_data['prices'] if k not in VALID_CABINS]
            for k in invalid_keys:
                del date_data['prices'][k]
                changed = True
        
        # Fix invalid cabin keys in available_seats (only if dict)
        if isinstance(date_data.get('available_seats'), dict):
            invalid_keys = [k for k in date_data['available_seats'] if k not in VALID_CABINS]
            for k in invalid_keys:
                del date_data['available_seats'][k]
                changed = True
        
        # Fix invalid status values
        if date_data.get('status') not in VALID_STATUSES:
            date_data['status'] = 'available'
            changed = True
    
    if changed:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?", (json.dumps(dates), fid))
        updated += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Updated {updated} flights")

# Verify
cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flights WHERE dates_json LIKE '%first%' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
print(f"Remaining with 'first': {cursor.fetchone()['cnt']}")

cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flights WHERE departure_time IS NULL AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
print(f"Remaining with NULL departure: {cursor.fetchone()['cnt']}")

cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flights WHERE dates_json LIKE '%premium_economy%' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
print(f"Remaining with premium_economy: {cursor.fetchone()['cnt']}")

cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM flights WHERE dates_json LIKE '%\"active\"%' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
print(f"Remaining with 'active' status: {cursor.fetchone()['cnt']}")

conn.close()
print("All fixes complete")
"""
await write_file("./fix_all.py", fix_all)
print("Script written")

fix_all_out = await run_command("python ./fix_all.py")

cursor.execute(\\"SELECT booking_id, passengers_json, user_id FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'\\")
rows = cursor.fetchall()
print(f'Total flight_bookings: {len(rows)}')

# Also get user DOBs for cross-reference
cursor.execute(\\"SELECT user_id, dob FROM users\\")
user_dobs = {r['user_id']: r['dob'] for r in cursor.fetchall()}

updated = 0
for row in rows:
    bid = row['booking_id']
    uid = row['user_id']
    pax_raw = row['passengers_json'] or '[]'
    passengers = json.loads(pax_raw)
    changed = False
    
    for p in passengers:
        if 'dob' not in p:
            # Use date_of_birth if present
            if 'date_of_birth' in p:
                p['dob'] = p['date_of_birth']
            # Try user's DOB
            elif uid in user_dobs and user_dobs[uid]:
                p['dob'] = user_dobs[uid]
            else:
                p['dob'] = '1990-01-01'
            changed = True
    
    if changed:
        cursor.execute('UPDATE flight_bookings SET passengers_json=? WHERE booking_id=?', (json.dumps(passengers), bid))
        updated += 1

conn.commit()
print(f'Updated {updated} bookings')

# Verify
cursor.execute(\\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flight_bookings WHERE passengers_json NOT LIKE '%dob%' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'\\")
remaining = cursor.fetchone()[0]
print(f'Remaining without dob: {remaining}')

conn.close()
print('Passenger fix complete')
